clue.text: Kitchen items subsequently put into containers

indicators.note: one piece is put into the other, so the word for later goes inside the containers

parts.note: packs are containers
subsequently means later

explanation.surface: Some kitchen things get boxed up afterwards.
explanation.definitionFit: Plate racks are kitchen stands for draining or storing crockery.

clue.text: Job given to character to provide a means of communication

parts.note: a post is a job
a card is a character, an eccentric person

explanation.surface: Someone takes on a role as a messenger.
explanation.definitionFit: A picture card sent by mail is a way of sending a short message.

clue.text: Heather, initially very good, is not very well

indicators.note: the very good part comes first, before the plant

parts.note: A1 means first-rate; written AI
ling is a name for common heather

explanation.surface: Heather, at first fine, is now poorly.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Heather' looks like a woman's name; it is the plant ling.
explanation.definitionFit: Ailing means sickly, in poor health.

clue.text: Make beloved stop with 'Attention!'

parts.note: to end is to stop
to lend an ear is to pay attention

explanation.surface: Someone calls a halt with a shout for attention.
explanation.definitionFit: To endear is to make someone liked or loved.

clue.text: A new religious study, not English, in multi-author book?

indicators.note: the religious study lacks the English letter

parts.note: theology is the study of religion

explanation.surface: A fresh book on religion lacking English, written by many.
explanation.definitionFit: An anthology collects pieces by various writers in one volume.

clue.text: Sit outside in fine weather — ashen but changing?

indicators.note: the letters of the two words are changing places

explanation.surface: Pale people sit outside in the sun hoping to change colour.
explanation.walkthrough: The ashen person is changing, getting a tan, which is the point.
explanation.definitionFit: To sunbathe is to sit or lie in the sun, typically in good weather.

clue.text: Smoother line of soldiers

definitions.meaning: a tool that smooths wood or metal, a rasp
soldiers marching one behind another, in single column

explanation.definitionFit: A file both smooths surfaces and names soldiers in a column, two unrelated senses.

clue.text: Chinese system that could involve fine hugs

indicators.note: the letters could be rearranged into another form

explanation.surface: An eastern philosophy might include a lot of cuddles.
explanation.definitionFit: Feng shui is the Chinese practice of arranging spaces for harmony.

clue.text: 'I need time to think' is what one buried in the crowd may say

definitions.meaning: a phrase said while pausing to consider

definitions.text: what one buried in the crowd may say
definitions.meaning: a request to be allowed a view, said by someone hidden deep in a throng

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase is both a stalling remark while thinking and a literal request to be allowed a view.

clue.text: Dependability of old hat I used in part of farm

indicators.note: the old hat and I are placed inside the farm enclosure

parts.note: a sty is the pig pen on a farm
a lid is slang for a hat

explanation.surface: Something about how reliable an old hat is when worn in a farm building.
explanation.definitionFit: Solidity of character means firmness and reliability, the quality of being dependable.

clue.text: Number classically participating in excursion

parts.note: the Roman way of writing this number, X and C, sits inside the word excursion, so the number written classically takes part in it

explanation.surface: An ancient number joins a day trip.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Classically' means in Roman numerals: XC is ninety, and those two letters appear in eXCursion.
explanation.definitionFit: XC is the Roman numeral for nine tens, the cardinal number after eighty-nine.

clue.text: PM has no hesitation going round pub — it adds a bit of spice

definitions.text: it adds a bit of spice

indicators.note: the trimmed name encircles the pub
the prime minister's name loses the letters of a hesitation

parts.note: David Cameron was UK Prime Minister 2010-16
er is a hesitant sound
an inn is a pub

explanation.surface: A prime minister speaks confidently on a pub visit, adding some spice.
explanation.walkthrough: CAMERON without ER leaves CAMON, which goes round INN.
explanation.definitionFit: Cinnamon is a bark spice used to flavour food, so it adds spice.

clue.text: Like many a church notice across, say, Ireland?

indicators.note: the notice stretches across, i.e. around, the island

parts.note: an ad is a notice or advertisement
Ireland is an example of an isle, which 'say' signals

explanation.surface: A church notice board covering Irish matters.
explanation.definitionFit: Many churches have aisles, passages between the pews, so they are aisled.

clue.text: One's sworn at husband, wanting love primarily

indicators.note: love must come first, before the other pieces

parts.note: love is zero in tennis, the letter O

explanation.surface: Someone shouts curses at a husband who lacks love above all.
explanation.walkthrough: 'One's sworn at' reads as being abused, but 'One's sworn' is the definition: something one swears.
explanation.definitionFit: A solemn promise or vow is something a person swears, hence one sworn.

clue.text: Come to end of line in attempt to expose infidelity

indicators.note: the two pieces go in the attempt

parts.note: a try is an attempt
to reach is to come to

indicators.note: the end of a word is its final letter, so only that one letter of line is used

explanation.surface: Arriving at the end of a queue in an attempt to reveal unfaithfulness.
explanation.definitionFit: Treachery is betrayal of trust, as is infidelity.

clue.text: Doctor needing a part of a big house for recreational activity?

parts.note: a wing is a section of a large house

explanation.surface: A doctor needs one section of a mansion.
explanation.definitionFit: Sketching pictures is a pastime, a hobby pursued for pleasure, hence the question mark.

clue.text: Group of soldier laid up — rest could be this

parts.note: REME is the Royal Electrical and Mechanical Engineers, a British army corps

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from the bottom

explanation.surface: A soldier's unit is laid up, and rest might be the cure.
explanation.walkthrough: 'laid up' suggests illness; here 'up' turns LAID into DIAL.
explanation.definitionFit: Rest can be a remedial measure, i.e. one that cures or corrects.

clue.text: Who rears unexpectedly? I'd better not, in battle

definitions.text: Who rears unexpectedly? I'd better not, in battle

indicators.note: the letters of the two words appear in an unexpected order

explanation.surface: A creature that rears up suddenly had better not do so in battle.
explanation.walkthrough: The whole clue describes a battle mount that must not rear.
explanation.definitionFit: A warhorse is a mount ridden into battle, which should not rear unexpectedly.

clue.text: One topless garment associated with popular music somewhere in America

indicators.note: the word for one loses its first letter

parts.note: taken as one
a bra is an undergarment
ska is a Jamaican popular music style

explanation.surface: Someone without a top, wearing a bra, linked with pop music in the US.
explanation.definitionFit: Nebraska is a state in the American Midwest.

clue.text: Soldiers getting punished to become improved

parts.note: RE, Royal Engineers, a British army corps
fined means punished with a penalty payment

explanation.surface: Troops are penalised in order to make them better.
explanation.definitionFit: Refined means purified or polished, made better than before.

clue.text: One stuck in Orlando wandering about — it's really dead!

indicators.note: the single letter is put inside the rearranged letters
the letters of Orlando wander into a new order

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Someone stranded wandering Orlando is utterly exhausted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wandering about' makes DOORNAL from ORLANDO; 'stuck in' puts I inside.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom 'dead as a doornail' makes the nail the type of something lifeless.

clue.text: Jane providing song for us to hear

indicators.note: the word for song is said out loud and spelt differently

parts.note: an air is a tune or song

explanation.surface: A woman named Jane offers to sing for an audience.
explanation.walkthrough: Jane Eyre is the heroine of Charlotte Brontë's novel.
explanation.definitionFit: Jane Eyre is the title heroine of the Brontë novel, so her surname completes the first name.

clue.text: Primitive life form to be gobbled up by a bird once

indicators.note: the reversed word is swallowed by the bird

parts.note: the moa is an extinct New Zealand bird

indicators.note: in a down clue, up means the word is read from bottom to top

explanation.surface: Early life is eaten by a now-extinct bird.
explanation.walkthrough: 'up' turns BE into EB, which 'gobbled' puts inside MOA.
explanation.definitionFit: An amoeba is a single-celled organism, a simple form of life.

clue.text: Little son, someone really small, a bit of a pain

parts.note: S is the abbreviation for son
titch is British slang for a tiny person

explanation.surface: A small child is something of a nuisance.
explanation.definitionFit: A stitch is a sharp pain in the side, typically after running.

clue.text: Patient finally given anaesthetic — it'll ensure lack of movement

indicators.note: only the final letter of patient is taken

parts.note: ether was an early anaesthetic

explanation.surface: A patient at last receives anaesthesia to keep them still.
explanation.definitionFit: A rope or chain that ties an animal to a post restricts its roaming.

clue.text: A lethal weapon, racism — terrible — it must be curbed

indicators.note: the rearranged letters hold the little word inside them, restraining it
terrible signals the letters of racism are put into a mess

explanation.surface: Racism is a terrible, deadly weapon that must be restrained.
explanation.walkthrough: 'terrible' makes SCIMAR from RACISM; 'must be curbed' puts IT inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: A scimitar is a curved oriental sword, a deadly blade.

clue.text: Shrub is hidden behind seaside building

indicators.note: the little word goes after, behind, the seaside structure

parts.note: a pier is a seafront structure

explanation.surface: Some bush lies concealed at the back of a beach building.
explanation.definitionFit: Pieris is a genus of evergreen flowering bushes from the heather family.

clue.text: Somehow detain this writer coming in — there's a medical disorder

indicators.note: the writer enters the rearranged letters
somehow signals the letters of detain are to be rearranged

parts.note: the setter refers to themselves as me

explanation.surface: A writer is detained because of a medical condition.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Somehow' turns DETAIN into DENTIA; 'coming in' puts ME inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Dementia is a progressive brain disorder affecting memory and thinking.

clue.text: Plant that's isolated deprived of nitrogen

indicators.note: the word for isolated loses one letter

parts.note: alone means isolated
N is the chemical symbol of nitrogen

explanation.surface: A lone plant is starved of nitrogen.
explanation.definitionFit: Aloe is a succulent plant genus, well known for soothing gel.

clue.text: Artist holy and unconventional when covering conflict

indicators.note: the rearranged letters wrap around the conflict
unconventional signals the letters of holy and are rearranged

parts.note: war is armed conflict

explanation.surface: An unorthodox, devout artist depicts warfare.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unconventional' makes ANDYHOL from HOLY AND, and 'when covering' puts WAR inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Andy Warhol was the American pop artist famous for soup-can prints.
